metadata.source: PGIMER Official OPD Schedule & Patient Welfare Guide 2026
metadata.disclaimer: Independent patient navigation aid. Not an official PGIMER publication. Room numbers, counters, and OPD timings are subject to change. Reconfirm at hospital help desk, signage, or test slip.

golden_rules.title: Identify Patient Concern First
golden_rules.hindi_title: मरीज की तकलीफ के हिसाब से विभाग चुनें
golden_rules.punjabi_title: ਮਰੀਜ਼ ਦੀ ਤਕਲੀਫ਼ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਵਿਭਾਗ ਚੁਣੋ

golden_rules.title: Not Everyone Goes to New OPD
golden_rules.hindi_title: हर मरीज को New OPD नहीं जाना (दिल, आंख, बच्चों की अलग इमारतें हैं)
golden_rules.punjabi_title: ਹਰ ਮਰੀਜ਼ ਨੂੰ ਨਿਊ ਓਪੀਡੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਜਾਣਾ

golden_rules.title: New Patient: Correct Token & CR Card
golden_rules.hindi_title: नया मरीज: सही काउंटर से टोकन और CR कार्ड बनवाएं
golden_rules.punjabi_title: ਨਵਾਂ ਮਰੀਜ਼: ਸਹੀ ਕਾਊਂਟਰ ਤੋਂ ਟੋਕਨ ਤੇ ਕਾਰਡ ਬਣਵਾਓ

golden_rules.title: Returning Patient: Never Make a Duplicate Card
golden_rules.hindi_title: पुराना मरीज: पुराना कार्ड व रिपोर्ट लाएं, नया कार्ड न बनवाएं
golden_rules.punjabi_title: ਪੁਰਾਣਾ ਮਰੀਜ਼: ਪੁਰਾਣਾ ਕਾਰਡ ਲਿਆਓ, ਨਵਾਂ ਕਾਰਡ ਨਾ ਬਣਵਾਓ

golden_rules.title: Test Slips Rule: Follow Doctor's Stamped Counter
golden_rules.hindi_title: टेस्ट पर्ची का नियम: पर्ची पर लिखा काउंटर ही मान्य है
golden_rules.punjabi_title: ਟੈਸਟ ਪਰਚੀ ਦਾ ਨਿਯਮ: ਪਰਚੀ ਵਾਲਾ ਕਾਊਂਟਰ ਹੀ ਦੇਖੋ

buildings.name: New OPD Block
buildings.description: General registration counters and multiple Medicine, Surgery & specialty clinics across various floors and blocks.

buildings.name: Advanced Cardiac Centre (ACC)
buildings.description: Dedicated specialty hospital for heart diseases and surgery. Reception & separate OPD registration.

buildings.name: Advanced Paediatric Centre (APC)
buildings.description: Dedicated children's specialty OPD and inpatient hospital. Separate registration.
buildings.landmark: Separate building next to Advanced Eye Centre

buildings.name: Advanced Eye Centre (AEC)
buildings.description: Dedicated ophthalmology building for eye treatments, retina checkups, and surgery.

buildings.name: Advanced Trauma Centre (ATC)
buildings.description: 24/7 dedicated acute emergency trauma care facility for severe accidents and urgent polytrauma.

buildings.name: Nehru Hospital / Emergency Block
buildings.description: Emergency hospital. Immediate triage care. Routine OPD card is NOT required to enter emergency.

departments.name: Medicine / Internal Medicine
departments.notes: Primary starting point in New OPD for adult patients.

departments.name: Pulmonary Medicine (Chest & Breathing)
departments.hindi_name: पल्मोनरी मेडिसिन / छाती एवं सांस विभाग
departments.notes: New OPD block. Ask at help desk if Medicine referral is needed.

departments.name: Cardiology (Heart Follow-up)
departments.notes: Advanced Cardiac Centre (ACC) — ALAG BUILDING. Do not look inside New OPD.

departments.name: Neurology / Medicine (Nerve & Brain)
departments.notes: Confirm OPD location and clinic room at New OPD ground floor desk.

departments.name: Orthopaedics (Bones & Joints)
departments.notes: Confirm room from New OPD help desk upon arrival.

departments.name: Gastroenterology / Medicine (Liver & Stomach)
departments.notes: Ask at help desk if internal referral from Medicine is needed first.

departments.name: Nephrology / Medicine (Kidney)
departments.notes: Ask at reception if initial Medicine referral is required.

departments.name: Urology (Urinary & Prostate)
departments.notes: New OPD specialty; confirm clinic room on registration.

departments.name: Obstetrics & Gynaecology (Women's Health)
departments.notes: Confirm clinic location and female registration counter in New OPD.

departments.name: Paediatrics (Children)
departments.notes: Advanced Paediatric Centre (APC) — ALAG BUILDING. Located near Advanced Eye Centre.

departments.name: Eye / Ophthalmology
departments.notes: Advanced Eye Centre (AEC) — ALAG BUILDING. Do not look in New OPD.

departments.name: ENT (Ear, Nose, Throat)
departments.notes: Confirm room from New OPD help desk.

departments.name: Oral Health Sciences (Dental)
departments.notes: Oral Health Sciences department reception in New OPD block.

departments.name: Medicine / Clinical Haematology (Blood Diseases)
departments.notes: Referral zaroori ho sakta hai. Inquire at Medicine registration desk first.

departments.name: Oncology (Cancer Specialty)
departments.notes: Specialty determined by cancer type; confirm referral at Central Help Desk.

weekdays.notes: Registration counters close strictly at 11:00 AM. Special clinics have separate days.

saturday_and_holidays.notes: Closed on Sundays. Emergency remains open 24/7.

opd_schedule.special_clinics_note: Special clinics ke din aur timing alag ho sakte hain. Registration time aur doctor consultation time ek jaise nahi hote.

sample_collection.verification_warning: Published directory reference. Current counter aur test eligibility zaroor confirm karein. Slip par doosra room ho to slip follow karein.
sample_collection.fasting_guidance: Har blood test mein fasting (khali pet) nahi hoti. Bina doctor ki salah ke regular medicines band mat karo.

sample_collection.verification_warning: Special drug-level testing ke published instructions. Routine blood tests ke liye nahi.

sample_collection.published_location: Department of Microbiology / Designated Lab Help Desk
sample_collection.verification_warning: Exact current counter verified nahi; test slip aur microbiology/lab help desk se poochhein.
Department-specific instructions follow karein; direct Room 127 assume na karein.

sample_collection.published_location: Radiology Department (Test slip ke hisaab se)
sample_collection.verification_warning: Exact room aur appointment counter confirm karein. CT aur Ultrasound ke liye pehle token/appointment zaroori hai.
Receipt, CR number aur lab instructions dekhein; report collection counter se samay poochhein.

emergency_warning_signs: Tez seene ka dard (Severe central chest pain / pressure)
Bahut saans phoolna (Extreme shortness of breath / gasping)
Ek taraf achanak kamzori ya paralysis (Sudden one-sided weakness / stroke sign)
Bahut bleeding ya badi chot (Severe bleeding, major road trauma)
Fit / daure ke baad hosh na aana (Unresponsive after a seizure)
emergency_instruction: Turant Emergency staff ko batao. Routine OPD registration card ka wait mat karo!
